name: Ann
preview: I moved from a place of crisis and emotional overwhelm to one of strength, clarity, and self-worth. I stopped doubting myself so much. I started trusting my instincts again.
text:
When I first came to Janine, I was in the middle of what felt like a never-ending storm. The breakdown of my marriage had left me emotionally exhausted, confused, and deeply destabilised. The 2.5-year divorce process only intensified everything — constant conflict, pressure, and a sense that I was losing myself in the chaos.

Talking with Janine changed that in ways I didn't expect. For the first time in a long time, I felt truly heard, without judgement, without being rushed, and without being made to feel like I was overreacting. She created a space where I could untangle what I was experiencing and start to make sense of it. She didn't tell me what to do. She helped me understand what I already knew, but had lost sight of.

The biggest shift was internal. I moved from a place of crisis and emotional overwhelm to one of strength, clarity, and self-worth. I stopped doubting myself so much. I started trusting my instincts again. I began to feel grounded, like I was standing on my own two feet rather than being swept along by everything happening around me.

As a result, I was able to engage with the divorce process from a completely different place — calm, clear, and on my terms. I wasn't reacting out of fear or confusion anymore. I was making decisions from a place of strength and self-respect.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Janine to any woman who feels overwhelmed by relationship pressure or conflict. If you need a space to be heard, to find clarity, and to reconnect with your own strength, this kind of support is truly invaluable.

name: Sue
preview: From our very first conversation, I felt heard and hopeful. Janine created a space where I could express emotions that felt difficult and guilt-laden, completely free from judgement.
text:
Navigating life in a blended family brought relationship challenges I genuinely didn't know how to face. Janine helped me understand and accept the reality of my situation without glossing over its difficulty, and from that honest foundation, she helped me see how to protect both myself and the relationships that matter most to me. What she gave me was something I hadn't expected: a renewed sense of self-control, without ever losing sight of my own accountability.

From our very first conversation, I felt heard and hopeful. Janine created a space where I could express emotions that felt difficult and guilt-laden, completely free from judgement. Simply being able to articulate my own thoughts out loud helped me see them more clearly and honestly than I ever had before.

That first session was pivotal. It gave me genuine hope that I could work through my difficulties on my own terms. That my life didn't have to be a constant compromise.

I cannot recommend Janine highly enough. If you're looking not just to be listened to, but to find real, workable clarity, she is exactly who you need.

name: JW
preview: In just one session, one topic that felt like an insurmountable problem has been dropped for me. It's truly incredible how effective this approach has been.
text:
Working with Janine has been genuinely life-changing. When I first started, I wanted to improve my confidence, independence, and break away from emotionally unhealthy relationships and guilt. Through our sessions, she helped me build a much healthier mindset and a stronger sense of self.

One of the biggest shifts for me has been my independence. I've gone from feeling hesitant about doing things on my own to embracing new experiences, travelling abroad, and doing solo activities in a way I never thought I would. A recent trip was a real turning point — I felt completely comfortable, settled, confident, and free.

I've seen very quickly how in just one session, one topic that felt like an insurmountable problem has been dropped for me. It's truly incredible how effective this approach has been for me, no doubt because of the way Janine has been a safe non-judgmental guide through this process.

I'm incredibly grateful for Janine. I know this will have real, lasting benefits.

name: Alison
preview: She gets to the heart of what you're grappling with through careful, thoughtful questioning, and she has a real gift for helping you untangle your thoughts.
text:
Janine is wonderful at making you feel welcome and heard. She gets to the heart of what you're grappling with through careful, thoughtful questioning, and she has a real gift for helping you untangle your thoughts and turn what feels like scattered ideas into a coherent plan for moving forward.

What I found especially powerful was her ability to carry themes forward across sessions whilst also holding space when I arrived with something completely new. At the end of every session I left with agreed action steps that felt both inspiring and genuinely achievable.

If you're feeling unclear about your next chapter and need someone to help you see what's possible, I can't recommend Janine highly enough.
